messages.en:
{07 00 00}Heya, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Didja
know the {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00} starts
today, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
I'm wondering who among us
will be chosen as the
{ff 00 00 02}greenest of thumbs{ff 00 00 00}.
We'll be picking the winner
next Sunday, {07 06 00}and I can't
wait, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Terekest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Kas sa
teadsid, et {ff 00 00 03}lillepidu{ff 00 00 00} algab
täna, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Ma mõtlen, kes meist
valitakse {ff 00 00 02}kõige rohelisema
näpuga{ff 00 00 00}.
Me valime võitja järgmisel
pühapäeval, {07 06 00}ja ma ei jõua
oodata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Time to get your gardening
gloves on, 'cause it's time
for the annual {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00}!
We've got a week to make
the most fabulous garden
we can.
When Sunday rolls around,
we'll find out who's got the
best garden in town.
The winner gets a {ff 00 00 07}trophy{ff 00 00 00}
and the coveted title of
{ff 00 00 02}Green Thumb{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}I recommend you start
planning and planting your
garden now!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aeg panna aiakindad kätte,
sest on aeg iga-aastaseks
{ff 00 00 03}lillepeoks{ff 00 00 00}!
Meil on nädal aega, et teha
kõige vapustavam aed,
mis suudame.
Kui pühapäev kätte jõuab,
saame teada, kellel on
linna parim aed.
Võitja saab {ff 00 00 07}karika{ff 00 00 00}
ja ihaldatud tiitli
{ff 00 00 02}rohenäpp{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Soovitan sul hakata kohe
oma aeda planeerima ja
istutama!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} hi!{01 00 00 05 00} How's your
garden coming along?
Planted lots of flowers?
You know, Sunday's when
we hold the final judging,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} tere!{01 00 00 05 00} Kuidas su
aiaga läheb?
Istutasid palju lilli?
Tead, pühapäeval toimub
lõplik hindamine,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}So, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} you've
probably got a nice, big
garden by now, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
How's it coming along?{01 00 00 05 00} You
know the {ff 00 00 02}Green Thumb{ff 00 00 00} will
be announced Sunday, right?
{07 14 00}I'm SO going to win. Beneath
these dirty fingers lurk
thumbs of purest green!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nii, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} sul on
ilmselt praeguseks kena
suur aed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Kuidas sellega läheb?{01 00 00 05 00} Sa
tead, et {ff 00 00 02}rohenäpp{ff 00 00 00}
kuulutatakse pühapäeval?
{07 14 00}Ma VÕIDAN kindlasti. Nende
mustade sõrmede all peituvad
kõige rohelisemad pöidlad!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, heya, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} So,
how green does your garden
grow, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Here's a little tip for you:
instead of planting tons
of the same flowers,
{07 0a 00}why don't you try mixing it
up by planting all sorts of
different flowers?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oh, terekest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Nii,
kui roheliselt su aed
kasvab, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Siin on sulle väike vihje:
selle asemel, et istutada
tonnide viisi samu lilli,
{07 0a 00}miks sa ei proovi segada,
istutades igasuguseid
erinevaid lilli?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} how are
your flowers doing? Are
they{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}still alive?
{07 00 00}You have until next Sunday,
so you'd better take good
care of them.
{07 14 00}Keep watering them every
day, unless you like your
flowers crunchy.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kuidas su
lilledel läheb? Kas nad
on{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}veel elus?
{07 00 00}Sul on aega järgmise
pühapäevani, nii et hoolitse
nende eest hästi.
{07 14 00}Kasta neid iga päev, kui
sa just ei taha krõbedaid
lilli.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00} wraps up
next Sunday, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}At the very least, you
should try to keep your
flowers alive until then.
{07 14 00}After all, this is your big
chance to show off your
green thumb, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 03}Lillepidu{ff 00 00 00} lõpeb järgmisel
pühapäeval, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}Vähemalt peaksid sa üritama
hoida oma lilled selle ajani
elus.
{07 14 00}Lõppude lõpuks on see su
suur võimalus näidata oma
rohelist näppu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, does your
garden have a theme to
tie it all up together?
I get bored of gardening
when I'm just planting and
watering and planting again.
{07 14 00}Giving myself a theme to
work with makes gardening
a lot more fun.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas su aial on
teema, mis seob kõik
kokku?
Mul hakkab aiandusest igav,
kui ma lihtsalt istutan ja
kastan ja istutan jälle.
{07 14 00}Endale teema seadmine teeb
aianduse palju
lõbusamaks.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's been a long and busy
week, but the {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00}
is finally wrapping up.
{07 00 00}I had a good week, but
I have my regrets.

{07 16 00}Like if I'd only tried harder
to plant a wider variety of
flowers{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on olnud pikk ja tegus
nädal, aga {ff 00 00 03}lillepidu{ff 00 00 00}
lõpeb lõpuks.
{07 00 00}Mul oli hea nädal, aga
mul on kahetsusi.

{07 16 00}Näiteks kui ma vaid oleksin
rohkem üritanud istutada
erinevamaid lilli{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}It's been a long, emotional
week for us all, I know.
Thank goodness it's over!
Today, we learn who will be
the {ff 00 00 02}Green Thumb{ff 00 00 00} and take
the {ff 00 00 07}Flower Fest trophy{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 16 00}I don't think it's going
to be me, though.{01 01 00}
{07 0f 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Makes me so sad.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See on olnud pikk ja
tundeline nädal, ma tean.
Hea, et see on läbi!
Täna saame teada, kes on
{ff 00 00 02}rohenäpp{ff 00 00 00} ja võtab
{ff 00 00 07}lillepeo karika{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 16 00}Ma ei arva, et see olen
mina.{01 01 00}
{07 0f 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Teeb mu nii kurvaks.

messages.en:
Great day for gardening,
isn't it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}When I even start thinking
about flowers, I feel fresh
and full of life.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma hakkan lilledest
mõtlemagi, tunnen end
värske ja elujõulisena.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Some people think flower
gardens are a waste of
time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
"Grow vegetables," they say.
"You can't eat flowers."{01 01 00}
{07 11 00}Well, I have news for them!
{07 0d 00}You CAN eat SOME flowers.{01 01 00}
{07 07 00}As long as you don't mind
the taste of aphids.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mõned inimesed arvavad, et
lilleaiad on ajaraiskamine,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Nad ütlevad: „Kasvata parem
köögivilja, lilli ei söö.”{01 01 00}
{07 11 00}Noh, mul on neile uudiseid!
{07 0d 00}MÕNDA lille SAAB süüa.{01 01 00}
{07 07 00}Kui sa just ei pahanda
lehetäide maitset.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}When I was little, I used to
like taking naps in flower
gardens, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}I mean, they're called
flowerbeds for a reason,
right?
{07 00 00}So anyway, my mom used to
get really mad when I'd
squish her flowers{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
She said I was free to
sleep in the neighbor's
gardens if I wanted, though.
{07 0a 00}Pretty soon, she had
the nicest{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}well, actually,
the only{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}garden in town!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma väike olin, meeldis
mulle lilleaedades
uinakuid teha, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}Ma mõtlen, neid kutsutakse
lillepeenardeks põhjusega,
eks?
{07 00 00}Igatahes, mu ema sai alati
väga vihaseks, kui ma ta
lilli litsusin{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
Ta ütles, et ma võin vabalt
magada naabri aedades,
kui tahan.
{07 0a 00}Üsna pea oli tal
kenaim{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}noh, tegelikult
ainus{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}aed linnas!

messages.en:
You know, you really ought
to put some flowers around
your room, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Even a few flowers can add
a lot of life to a place.
messages.et:
Tead, sa peaksid tõesti
panema oma tuppa mõned
lilled, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Isegi paar lille võib lisada
kohale palju elu.
